Synthetic Android v1-format fixture, independently encoded with Python using BackupFormat.kt/BackupJson canonical rules. Contains no personal data. Includes LONG max, control characters and a note-deletion tombstone. This is a format compatibility fixture, not a real device export.

pwa-roundtrip.zip: generated by the actual TypeScript exportBackup implementation using synthetic favorites/notes/folders and an unknown LONG greater than JavaScript's safe integer. android-roundtrip.zip: that archive decoded, re-exported and re-read by the original Android BackupFormat.kt compiled on the JVM. interop.test.ts verifies equality when imported back into TypeScript. No user data is included.
